provider_candidate.selection_basis: Official IBM changelog states ibm_kingston is available to Open Plan users.

sdk_observation.material_change: EstimatorV2 and SamplerV2 are deprecated in favor of client-side Estimator and Sampler interfaces.
sdk_observation.implementation_consequence: Any later preflight must pin the actually installed client and avoid assuming Delta 20/21 primitive interfaces remain current.

stop_conditions_triggered: fresh target snapshot unavailable without an authenticated provider session
exact target-specific route and native conformance not established
provider-native pricing or quota provenance and bounded cost ceiling not frozen
explicit consent, job ceiling, shot ceiling and budget are absent
required_next_outputs: authenticated read-only target snapshot with timestamp and SHA-256
exact circuit digest and target-specific transpilation
native instruction and coupling-map conformance certificate
held-fixed ideal reference and accepted-output quality threshold
same-provider pricing or quota source with observation timestamp
bounded jobs, shots and cost proposal for explicit user approval
nonclaims: not real-QPU execution or hardware-quality evidence
not authorization to initialize a service or submit a job
not quantum advantage, GPU replacement, Data-Center-to-Phone, RAM, VRAM or storage replacement evidence
not material, bio-oil, fusion, WACC or new-physical-law evidence
